title: Slovakian Sausage-Free Goulash
description: A hearty, vegetarian take on a classic Slovakian dish, using sausages made from bake and seasoned with pickle spice.

ingredients.name: Bake Sausages
ingredients.notes: Made from bake and seasoned with pickle spice

instructions: Heat Nuka in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped Pickle and cook until softened.
Add the Bake Sausages and cook until browned.
Add the Slovakian Paprika, Nuka, and Caraway seeds. Stir well.
Add the Naughty Mushroom-based broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with Slovakian Paprika to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped Pickle.
